title: Stop Paying the build_runner Tax: Why I Refuse to Use Mockito in Modern Dart
why_read: A practical opinion piece on ditching code-generated Mockito mocks in Dart/Flutter for the faster, generation-free mocktail library.
analysis: The article argues against using Mockito with build_runner code generation in Dart/Flutter testing, citing the friction of waiting on codegen every time an interface changes during TDD. It advocates switching to mocktail, a mocking library that doesn't require code generation, to preserve developer flow state. This is a fairly common and well-trodden opinion in the Flutter community, so while it's a legitimate practical tip, it doesn't offer deep novel technical insight beyond what many Flutter developers already know or have argued elsewhere. Useful primarily for Dart/Flutter developers still using Mockito who haven't considered alternatives.
